text: Brent crude fell 8.7% to settle at $94.62 after Vance blamed the Iran war for the midterm losses and Trump said there were no immediate plans to strike Iran.
Gold rose about 3.4% to near $4,060, back above $4,000, as the dollar and yields fell after the Democratic sweep.
Gold miners jumped: GDX closed up 8.98% at $84.57 and GDXJ up 9.62% at $104.24.
Silver rose about 5% to near $52.30, and AGQ closed up 10.56% at $48.90.
The 10-year Treasury yield fell to about 4.88% and the 2-year to about 4.57% as oil dropped.
The S&P 500 rose 1.6% and the Dow 3%, while the Nasdaq gained 1.4% as AI-related stocks lagged.
The VIX fell about 20% to 16.61, back well below 20.
The dollar index fell to about 101.5 after touching its lowest since September, but the yen barely gained as stocks rallied.
